posts.title: 📊 NeatStats
posts.description: The recently launched NeatStats comes as a pleasant surprise: NeatStats makes it easy to learn about how, when, and where people view your website. We respect everyone’s privacy by only working with basic information that browsers already share with web servers, nothing more. We don’t log any IP addresses, and we have a ton of fun features.
